name: Snowflake Like
description: A favourite toggle whose snow crystal fills from its centre and throws six tiny flakes along its arms, with an optional count that ticks.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Whether it is on, when controlled.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Whether it starts on, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new state when pressed.

props.name: count
props.description: How many others have favourited it. One is added while it is on, and the number rolls when it changes. Leave it out for an icon-only button.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32, 36 or 44 pixels, with a 16, 20 or 24 pixel crystal.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. The count is added to it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components ToggleButton.
